Then iterate the replicated TArray CutActors (data ptr byte 0x10a0, count byte 0x10a8, 0x60-byte entries). has_authority_guard.meaning: HasAuthority()-style guard: only the authority hides the cut actors.

set_actor_enable_collision.asm_summary: AActor::SetActorEnableCollision(bool bEnableCollision). First instruction reads AActor byte 0x5c, shifts right 2 and masks bit 0 to get bActorEnableCollision; if it already equals the argument it returns (no-op). Otherwise it sets byte 0x5c bit 2 to the argument and reapplies collision on the actor's components (STAT_GetComponentsTime scope, component iteration + SetCollisionEnabled virtual 0x380 on each; root-component state at 0x14c / 0x360/0x10/0x74).
set_actor_enable_collision.meaning: AActor::SetActorEnableCollision(false). Called here with false (hide disables collision for actors that had it enabled when cut).

set_actor_hidden_in_game.asm_summary: Virtual call actor->vtable[0x2f8](actor, 1). In MulticastHideCutActors the second argument is 1 (true); in the sibling MulticastRestoreCutActors (slot 0xb40 = 0x14267b260) the same slot is called with 0 (false). The hide/restore pairing identifies it as AActor::SetActorHiddenInGame(bool bHidden).
